request.spec: Let me mark an invoice as paid. Keep a record every time I do so I can check back later.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Let me mark an invoice as paid. Keep a record every time I do so I can check back later.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Both tests pass. The full-stack change is complete:

- **Migration** (`V5__invoice_status.sql`): adds a `status` column to `invoice`, defaulting to `UNPAID`.
- **Server**:
  - `Invoice` entity + `InvoiceView` carry the status; new invoices default to `UNPAID`, and list/create endpoints surface it.
  - New `PayInvoiceLogic` + `rest/api/invoices/{invoiceId}/pay.POST.yml` endpoint flips an invoice to `PAID`, saves it, and records one audit line `INVOICE_PAID id=<id> amount=<amount>` via the `Audit` service.
  - `TestSupportController` seed now inserts the fixture's `status` (defaulting to `UNPAID`); `reset` already truncates `invoice`.
- **Front-end** (`ProjectInvoices.tsx`): each row shows its status (`invoice-status`) and, while `UNPAID`, a `invoice-pay-<id>` button that POSTs to the pay endpoint and reloads.

All additive and local — no changes to shared router, pinned scaffolding, or the spec.
